In case an existing data type is changed in a new ap-
plication, Persistency expects PersistencyKeyValueDataTypeMappings
referring to a copy of the old data type as previousDataType and the new data type
as currentDataType. The name of the old data type shall be formed as follows:
<PersistencyKeyValueDataTypeMapping.currentDataType.shortName>_<
PersistencyKeyValueDataTypeMapping.previousExecutableVersion>.
